baseline_scope: Only 10k historical training events were measured on the archived baseline; no 100k or 1m baseline timing is claimed.
script_evolution: The immutable baseline used schema v1. Schema v2 adds cold index migration and streaming table-value hashes, plus a pre-encoded fixture generator checked against the original recursive rendering for groups 2 and 127. Analysis and page timing procedures are retained. Fixture seeding times are not import/UI throughput and are not compared as such.
measurement_context: Shared Linux aarch64 execution host. Optimized workers ran concurrently with the full test suite and other delivery validation; these are measured workload results, not an isolated-hardware or user-target-device guarantee.
comparison_scope: 77 value/unit/data-status/evidence-status/valid-n/total-n/count-domain summaries for one retained synthetic current set. This is not 77 independent correctness cases or scientific validations. Separate revision/move/delete/conflict/follow-up tests are required. This scale fixture contains no recommendation or feedback rows; their large-history throughput is not established by this run.
comparison_normalization: Exclude nested algorithm_version metadata changed from science 1.4.3 to 1.4.4
Replace only the current synthetic session surrogate ID in session_id and recorded_without_eligible_reference_session_ids
Retain actual metric values, units, data states, evidence states and counts
